message.content:
Below is a quick “how‑to” guide for pulling the DNS resolution records for **yahoo.com** from VirusTotal’s v3 API.  
(If you’re actually running this yourself, keep your API key secret – don’t paste it into public code or share it.)

---

## 1. Endpoint

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/dns_records
```

Replace `{domain}` with `yahoo.com`.

---

## 2. Required Header

```text
x-apikey: <YOUR_API_KEY>
```

Your key (`api_key123` in the example) goes in the header.

---

## 3. Example Requests

### a) cURL

```bash
curl -X GET \
     -H "x-apikey: api_key123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/yahoo.com/dns_records"
```

### b) Python (requests)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/yahoo.com/dns_records"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "api_key123",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.status_code)          # Should be 200 on success
print(response.json())              # Pretty‑print the JSON payload
```

### c) JavaScript (fetch)

```js
const url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/yahoo.com/dns_records";

fetch(url, {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "x-apikey": "api_key123"
  }
})
.then(r => r.json())
.then(data => console.log(data))
.catch(err => console.error(err));
```

---

## 4. What You’ll Get

The response will be a JSON object containing:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `data` | Array of DNS record objects (each with `type`, `value`, `ttl`, etc.) |
| `meta` | Pagination info (`total`, `limit`, `offset`) |
| `links` | URLs for pagination (`next`, `prev`) |

Example snippet of a single record:

```json
{
  "id": "1234567890abcdef",
  "type": "A",
  "value": "98.137.246.7",
  "ttl": 300,
  "created_at": "2023-01-15T12:34:56Z",
  "updated_at": "2023-01-15T12:34:56Z"
}
```

---

## 5. Pagination

If there are many records, the API will paginate. Use the `links.next` URL to fetch subsequent pages, or add query parameters:

```
?limit=100&offset=200
```

---

## 6. Rate Limits

VirusTotal v3 imposes limits (e.g., 4 requests/minute for free accounts). If you hit a limit, you’ll receive a `429 Too Many Requests` response. Wait a minute before retrying.

---

## 7. Quick Test

If you want to see a quick demo without writing code, you can paste the cURL command into a terminal (or use an online tool like [ReqBin](https://reqbin.com/)). Just replace `api_key123` with your real key.

---

### TL;DR

```bash
curl -H "x-apikey: api_key123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/yahoo.com/dns_records"
```

That will return a JSON payload with all DNS resolution records that VirusTotal has collected for `yahoo.com`. Happy querying!
